steps.content: The alarm sounds again. After around three seconds, you pick up the internal phone.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Hella broke out again...
Sigh... What is she doing? What about Ninety-Nine?

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Ninety-Nine is still there, but she won't say anything.
...Okay, I'll head right over.
When you get to the cells, Nightingale is already guarding the door. Support staff are buzzing around the cell door.
The door of Cell 177 has been pushed open from the inside, and the electronic components are still buzzing and sparking. It's clear at a glance that it was Ninety-Nine who did this.
But what's weird is that Ninety-Nine is still quietly sitting in the corner, rubbing her eyes as if she's sleepy—even though every sign shows that she was the author of this breakout.
Something isn't right. If Hella broke out, she wouldn't leave Ninety-Nine here.
Unless, they have another move planned.
Nightingale, she didn't start any trouble?
You turn around, and ask Nightingale in a voice low enough that only the two of you can hear.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: The information team has already started scanning security footage in the city... There hasn't been any trouble, and there's no trace of Hella after she escaped the Bureau.
You don't quite hear Nightingale's answer, because you see that Ninety-Nine, sitting in the corner, has opened her eyes and is staring at you, then blinks twice.
You stare at each other for around three seconds before you realize all of a sudden that Ninety-Nine is hinting that she wants to speak to you quietly.
Nightingale notices your change in expression, and is about to turn her head when you pull her to the side and whisper a set of coordinates.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Hella's coordinates?
Yeah, she's stopped. You should hurry and take advantage.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: By myself?
You won't have a hard time bringing Hella in, we should be able to wrap it up this morning. I'll deal with "quiet Ninety-Nine."
Nightingale nods with no hesitation.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Understood. I'll head off.
Once Nightingale is gone, you clap your hands to get the support staff to all leave.
So. What is she doing this time?
Ninety-Nine stays silent and slips you a piece of paper.
test
test
test
test
test
test
"Hmph! You'll never hold me, and you'll never find me!"
The handwriting is crooked, but the provocation is clear.
You sigh. You basically understand the nature of this "prison break."
This is my first time seeing such a sloppy prison break. Don't worry, I'll bring her right back.
Half an hour later, you arrive in front of a run-down two-story building in the south part of Syndicate territory.

Hella is inside, the shackles told you that.
The coordinates you gave Nightingale were in the completely opposite direction.
It's not a bad hideout...
Even though the little building is rundown, the inside is pretty sturdy. You go upstairs, where one door is ajar.
Hel—
As you're about to call out Hella's name, you hear a rummaging noise in the room.
Ah... Really, how many cans did she collect!

It's Hella's voice!
Heart racing, you quietly approach, keeping as quiet as possible, and look through the door.
The house is still in surprisingly good shape inside. The furniture and appliances are all arranged in the room.
You even see a few notes on the refrigerator by the door. The crooked letters are all in Hella's handwriting, and they're all common sense tips for Ninety-Nine.

options: Go straight in to find Hella.

choices.text: Go straight in to find Hella.

steps.content: You find a training recording saved in your communicator and press play.

steps.speaker: Recording
steps.content: Attention! This is an MBCC task force! You are surrounded!

steps.speaker: Recording
steps.content: All Sinners! Place your hands on your heads and exit the room! Do not resist!

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: ****, how did they get here so fast?
A clattering noise comes from the bedroom, and you faintly hear Hella muttering.
After a couple of minutes, the door to the bedroom is slowly pushed open from the inside. The girl cautiously exits the room.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: What are you doing here by yourself? Where's the team?
You shrug your shoulders.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: ****, you're so mean!!
When she realizes she's been tricked, Hella becomes hopping mad.
You hold your breath and carefully push open the bedroom door.
Inside, Hella is putting things in a suitcase. She's made a mess of the bed, with clothes and a pile of random things scattered all over.
You accidentally kick a plastic water bottle, and surprise Hella so that she spins around and lets out a shout.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: ****! Who the **** was that?!
Once she sees that it's you, Hella stamps her foot and blushes.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: You! When did you get here!
In a panic, Hella carelessly tips over the suitcase, and all of her carefully packed things scatter everywhere.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: No! No no no! How did you find me?

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Nobody knows that we live here! Wait... did Ninety-Nine tell you!!

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: She can't do anything right! She's even turned into a little snitch!

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Just wait until I get back! Then I'll fix her...!
When she realizes what she's let slip, Hella slams her mouth shut.
You sigh.
So, what did you come here to do?

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: To pack my bags and get ready to go on a long trip!
Go? Where could you go all by yourself?
You take a step forward. Hella looks as panicked as a rabbit, about to run.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: What do you care!
Okay, it's none of my business. But I have to think about Ninety-Nine... Are you really going to abandon your family and run away alone?

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: I'm not running away! It's because... because...
Seeing Hella's flushed face as she racks her brain to figure out what she wants to say, you laugh softly.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: I... I came early to pack! You know that Ninety-Nine is too obvious. If I took her into the city, there would be a whole team after us in a second.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: She doesn't have any common sense, it would be asking for trouble. And, she's pissed off a lot of people. You know better than I do!
Yeah, that's right.
So, now what? Now that I've caught you, are you going to resist arrest? Or are you going back to the Bureau with me?
Hella makes a noise.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Hmph! I, the great Hella, know when I've been beat!

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: I'll... go back to the Bureau with you...
Seeing that Hella has softened, you stand by the door and beckon to her.
Hella doesn't look at you, and runs back to pile all of her luggage into a trunk, then presses it to shut with her whole body weight.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Oh right! I forgot to stress this:

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: I am just staying there temporarily. Temporarily! Got it?

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: You better take good care of me, you hear? Or else I could just run away, like I did today!

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: That's right!

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: What question could you possibly still have?

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: If you've got something to say, then say it while I'm still in a good mood!
You straighten your uniform and clear your throat, then very properly ask Hella.
Since you have agreed to come with me to "stay temporarily," then, may I take that to mean... that we are friends now?
This time, Hella's face turns as red as a beet.
She lowers her head and quietly mumbles something.
What did you say? I couldn't hear you.
The girl raises her head and moves her lips, but no sound comes out.
Yeeees...?
You draw the word out.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: I said...
Go on, I'm listening.
Hella can't take your teasing anymore, and yells out unhappily.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: I said! Thank you! Thank you for saving us! Thank you for curing Ninety-Nine's infection!
When she's done, Hella picks up her suitcase and runs out without looking back.
She is... not even a little bit candid.
At that moment, you hear a knock on the door. You look back, and you see Nightingale looking coolly at you with arms crossed.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Chief, could you give me a reason that you and the target are in a building in the opposite direction of where you said she would be?
You curse under your breath and start thinking of an excuse.
Hrm... Maybe it's because, since I was still recovering from my fight with Ninety-Nine, I mixed up the directions for a moment.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: "In order to evade capture, the target relocated. The Chief was concerned about a delay, and acted alone." I will put that in the formal report.
Thank you, Nightingale.
In the end, this farce of a prison break was resolved in just under half a day.
In the final submitted report, you record in detail the process of arresting the escapee Hella, uncovering her nest in the Syndicate southern district.
As for the loot and evidence, Nightingale and a group of officers packed it all up and carried it back to the Bureau.
